candidates.change_summary: Replace selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender)) with a no-op (empty statement) so the contract does not self-destruct.
Delete the require statement so anyone can trigger the self-destruct, changing which callers succeed.
Replace selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender)) with selfdestruct(payable(address(0))) so ETH is sent to zero address instead of msg.sender.
